product_concept: A focused calculator / spreadsheet that helps independent nail / lash / brow technicians price services profitably and confidently without losing clients.
core_problem: Trained in technique, not business; pricing is guesswork and they fear raising prices.
related_problems: I don't know what to charge
don't know my real profit margin
desired_outcome: Price services profitably and confidently without losing clients.
core_transformation: From: Trained in technique, not business; pricing is guesswork and they fear raising prices.  →  To: Price services profitably and confidently without losing clients.
product_promise: Get to 'Price services profitably and confidently without losing clients.' without the usual guesswork.
why_this_format: Chosen from problem language, not by default. Signal scores: {'calculator / spreadsheet': 10, 'fill-in templates / scripts': 1, 'planner / schedule': 0, 'guide / checklist': 3}.
exclude: Anything freely available and already good enough
differentiation: pricing confidence/scripts, not just a calculator
price_range: Unknown — infer from analogous products before pricing
price_rationale: Unknown pricing evidence; do not set a price until validated.
key_customer_language: I don't know what to charge
don't know my real profit margin
key_objections: Templates never fit my exact case
evidence_summary: 3 observed + 1 inferred/other claims support a recurring problem for independent nail / lash / brow technicians. Gap: trade-specific consumables-per-service cost math (gel/acrylic/lash-fan usage); pricing confidence/scripts, not just a calculator.
